```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), "..", "_common", "repro_paths.R"))
paths <- repro_paths("Code_chapter05")
repo_root <- paths$repo_root
input_dir <- paths$input_dir
data_dir <- file.path(paths$results_dir, "output_data")
fig_dir <- data_dir
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Load required packages ---
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(wCorr)

# --- Step 1: Read data ---
cat("=== Step 1: Read data ===\n")
final_l2fc_matrix_drugs_only <- read.xlsx(
  file.path(input_dir, "12_Final_L2FC_Matrix_Drugs_Only_367_with_label.xlsx"),rowNames = TRUE)

mat <- as.matrix(final_l2fc_matrix_drugs_only)
cat("Matrix dimensions: Number of proteins =", nrow(mat), "; Number of drugs =", ncol(mat), "\n\n")

# --- Step 2: Calculate Spearman correlation matrix ---
cat("=== Step 2: Calculate Spearman correlation matrix ===\n")
drug_cor_spearman <- cor(mat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cat("Correlation matrix dimensions:", dim(drug_cor_spearman), "\n\n")

# --- Step 3: Find the most similar partner for each drug ---
cat("=== Step 3: Find the most similar partner for each drug ===\n")

# 3a. Prepare data
cor_matrix_spearman <- drug_cor_spearman
if (is.null(rownames(cor_matrix_spearman))) {
  rownames(cor_matrix_spearman) <- colnames(cor_matrix_spearman)
}
diag(cor_matrix_spearman) <- NA  # Remove self-correlations

# 3b. Convert to long format
full_pairs_list_spearman <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(cor_matrix_spearman), 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(full_pairs_list_spearman) <- c("Drug1", "Drug2", "Correlation")
full_pairs_list_spearman <- na.omit(full_pairs_list_spearman)

# 3c. Use split() and lapply() to find the best match
list_by_drug1_spearman <- split(
  full_pairs_list_spearman, 
  full_pairs_list_spearman$Drug1
)

best_match_rows_spearman <- lapply(list_by_drug1_spearman, function(df) {
  df_sorted <- df[order(df$Correlation, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  return(df_sorted[1, ])
})

best_match_per_drug_spearman <- do.call(rbind, best_match_rows_spearman)
rownames(best_match_per_drug_spearman) <- NULL
names(best_match_per_drug_spearman) <- c("Drug", "BestMatch", "Spearman_Correlation")

# 3d. Sort by correlation
best_match_per_drug_spearman <- best_match_per_drug_spearman[
  order(best_match_per_drug_spearman$Spearman_Correlation, decreasing = TRUE), 
]

cat("Most similar partner for each drug (Top 30):\n")
print(head(best_match_per_drug_spearman, 30))
cat("\n")

# --- Step 4: Reduce to unique drug pairs (remove duplicates) ---
cat("=== Step 4: Reduce to unique drug pairs ===\n")

# 4a. Create standardized drug-pair IDs
sorted_pairs_spearman <- t(apply(
  best_match_per_drug_spearman[, c("Drug", "BestMatch")], 
  1, 
  sort
))

# 4b. Merge and remove duplicates
temp_df_spearman <- cbind(sorted_pairs_spearman, best_match_per_drug_spearman)
names(temp_df_spearman)[1:2] <- c("Sorted_Drug1", "Sorted_Drug2")
unique_rows_spearman <- !duplicated(temp_df_spearman[, c("Sorted_Drug1", "Sorted_Drug2")])
unique_best_match_pairs_spearman <- temp_df_spearman[unique_rows_spearman, ]

# 4c. Select and rename final columns
final_unique_pairs_spearman <- unique_best_match_pairs_spearman[, 
  c("Sorted_Drug1", "Sorted_Drug2", "Spearman_Correlation")
]
names(final_unique_pairs_spearman)[1:2] <- c("Drug1", "Drug2")

# 4d. Re-sort
final_unique_pairs_spearman <- final_unique_pairs_spearman[
  order(final_unique_pairs_spearman$Spearman_Correlation, decreasing = TRUE), 
]
rownames(final_unique_pairs_spearman) <- NULL

cat("Reduced unique best-matching drug pairs (Top 30):\n")
print(head(final_unique_pairs_spearman, 30))
cat(paste("\nAfter reduction,", nrow(final_unique_pairs_spearman), "unique drug relationships remain\n\n"))

# Export results
data_dir <- file.path(paths$results_dir, "output_data")
#write.xlsx(final_unique_pairs_spearman, file.path(data_dir, "01_final_unique_pairs_spearman.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# --- Step 5: Define differential protein matrix ---
cat("=== Step 5: Define differential protein matrix ===\n")

# Empirical threshold, can be adjusted according to the data distribution
lfc_thr <- 0.75  
cat("Log2FC threshold set to:", lfc_thr, "\n")

# TRUE/FALSE matrix: whether the protein satisfies |log2FC| >= threshold under each drug treatment
resp_mat <- abs(mat) >= lfc_thr
resp_mat[is.na(resp_mat)] <- FALSE  # Convert NA to FALSE

cat("Total number of differential proteins (in at least one drug):", 
    sum(apply(resp_mat, 1, any)), "\n\n")

# --- Step 6: Define a function to calculate multidimensional metrics for drug pairs ---
cat("=== Step 6: Calculate multidimensional metrics for all drug pairs ===\n")

get_pair_metrics <- function(d1, d2, mat, resp, min_n_strong = 10) {
  # Spearman correlation across all proteins (overall profile similarity)
  v1_all <- mat[, d1]
  v2_all <- mat[, d2]
  ok_all <- !(is.na(v1_all) | is.na(v2_all))
  
  if (sum(ok_all) >= 2) {
    cor_all <- suppressWarnings(
      cor(v1_all[ok_all], v2_all[ok_all], method = "spearman")
    )
  } else {
    cor_all <- NA_real_
  }
  
  # Take the union: differential proteins in either d1 or d2
  idx_union <- resp[, d1] | resp[, d2]
  idx_use <- idx_union & ok_all
  n_union_use <- sum(idx_use)
  
  if (is.na(n_union_use) || n_union_use < min_n_strong) {
    return(data.frame(
      drug1      = d1,
      drug2      = d2,
      cor_all    = cor_all,
      cor_strong = NA_real_,
      n_strong   = n_union_use,
      jaccard    = NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  v1 <- v1_all[idx_use]
  v2 <- v2_all[idx_use]
  
  cor_strong <- suppressWarnings(
    cor(v1, v2, method = "spearman")
  )
  
  # Calculate Jaccard similarity
  idx1 <- resp[, d1]
  idx2 <- resp[, d2]
  union_resp  <- idx1 | idx2
  inter_resp  <- idx1 & idx2
  n_union     <- sum(union_resp)
  n_intersect <- sum(inter_resp)
  jaccard <- if (n_union > 0) n_intersect / n_union else NA_real_
  
  data.frame(
    drug1      = d1,
    drug2      = d2,
    cor_all    = cor_all,
    cor_strong = cor_strong,
    n_strong   = n_union_use,
    jaccard    = jaccard,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Step 7: Calculate metrics for all drug pairs ---
drugs <- colnames(mat)
cat("Starting calculation of metrics for", choose(length(drugs), 2), "drug pairs...\n")

pair_list <- combn(
  drugs, 2,
  FUN = function(x) {
    get_pair_metrics(
      d1 = x[1],
      d2 = x[2],
      mat = mat,
      resp = resp_mat,
      min_n_strong = 10
    )
  },
  simplify = FALSE
)

pair_res <- do.call(rbind, pair_list)
cat("Calculation completed!\n\n")

# --- Step 8: View metric distributions ---
cat("=== Step 8: Overview of metric distributions ===\n")
cat("\nGlobal correlation (cor_all):\n")
print(summary(pair_res$cor_all))
cat("\nDifferential protein correlation (cor_strong):\n")
print(summary(pair_res$cor_strong))
cat("\nJaccard similarity:\n")
print(summary(pair_res$jaccard))
cat("\nNumber of differential proteins:\n")
print(summary(pair_res$n_strong))
cat("\n")

# --- Step 9: Filter candidate drug pairs ---
cat("=== Step 9: Filter highly correlated candidate drug pairs ===\n")

# Threshold settings (can be adjusted according to the distributions above)
cor_all_thr    <- 0.5   # Global correlation
cor_strong_thr <- 0.5   # Correlation among differential proteins
jaccard_thr    <- 0.3   # Jaccard similarity of differential protein sets
n_strong_thr   <- 30    # Number of differential proteins

cat("Filtering thresholds:\n")
cat("  - Global correlation >=", cor_all_thr, "\n")
cat("  - Differential protein correlation >=", cor_strong_thr, "\n")
cat("  - Jaccard similarity >=", jaccard_thr, "\n")
cat("  - Number of differential proteins >=", n_strong_thr, "\n\n")

candidates <- pair_res %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cor_all),
    !is.na(cor_strong),
    cor_all    >= cor_all_thr,
    cor_strong >= cor_strong_thr,
    jaccard    >= jaccard_thr,
    n_strong   >= n_strong_thr
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(cor_strong))

cat("Number of candidate drug pairs meeting the criteria:", nrow(candidates), "\n\n")
cat("Top 30 candidate drug pairs:\n")
print(head(candidates, 30))

# --- Step 10: Calculate weighted Spearman correlation ---
cat("\n=== Step 10: Calculate weighted Spearman correlation ===\n")

weighted_spearman <- function(d1, d2, mat) {
  v1 <- mat[, d1]
  v2 <- mat[, d2]
  ok <- !(is.na(v1) | is.na(v2))
  v1 <- v1[ok]
  v2 <- v2[ok]
  
  if (length(v1) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  
  w <- (abs(v1) + abs(v2)) / 2
  if (all(w == 0 | is.na(w))) return(NA_real_)
  
  suppressWarnings(
    weightedCorr(
      x = v1,
      y = v2,
      weights = w,
      method = "Spearman"
    )
  )
}

# Add weighted Spearman correlation to candidate drug pairs
if (nrow(candidates) > 0) {
  candidates$w_spearman <- mapply(
    weighted_spearman,
    d1 = candidates$drug1,
    d2 = candidates$drug2,
    MoreArgs = list(mat = mat)
  )
  
  candidates <- candidates %>%
    arrange(desc(w_spearman))
  
  cat("Weighted Spearman correlation added successfully!\n")
  cat("\nTop 20 candidate drug pairs (sorted by weighted Spearman):\n")
  print(head(candidates, 20))
}

# --- Step 11: Export results ---
cat("\n=== Step 11: Export results ===\n")


write.xlsx(pair_res, file.path(data_dir, "02_all_drug_pairs_metrics.xlsx"))
write.xlsx(candidates, file.path(data_dir, "03_selected_drug_pairs_candidates.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- Read data ---
drug_pairs <- read.xlsx(file.path(input_dir, "04_network_edges_0.5.xlsx"))

cat("Original total number of drug pairs:", nrow(drug_pairs), "\n")

# ============================================================
# Step 1: Set correlation thresholds and filter
# ============================================================

cor_threshold <- 0.5  # Basic threshold
cor_highlight <- 0.7  # Highlight threshold

drug_pairs_filtered <- drug_pairs %>%
  filter(Spearman_Correlation >= cor_threshold) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_type = ifelse(Spearman_Correlation >= cor_highlight, 
                       "Strong (≥0.7)", 
                       "Moderate (0.5-0.7)")
  )

cat("Number of drug pairs with correlation >=", cor_threshold, ":", nrow(drug_pairs_filtered), "\n")
cat("  Among them, >=", cor_highlight, "(strong correlation):", 
    sum(drug_pairs_filtered$Spearman_Correlation >= cor_highlight), "\n")
cat("  Between", cor_threshold, "-", cor_highlight, "(moderate correlation):", 
    sum(drug_pairs_filtered$Spearman_Correlation < cor_highlight), "\n\n")

# ============================================================
# Step 2: Organize the DRP classification for each drug
# ============================================================

drug_drp_1 <- drug_pairs_filtered %>%
  select(Drug = Drug1, DRP = DRP_1) %>%
  distinct()

drug_drp_2 <- drug_pairs_filtered %>%
  select(Drug = Drug2, DRP = DRP_2) %>%
  distinct()

drug_info <- bind_rows(drug_drp_1, drug_drp_2) %>%
  distinct(Drug, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(DRP = as.character(DRP))

cat("Total number of drugs in the network:", nrow(drug_info), "\n\n")

# ============================================================
# Step 3: Define DRP color scheme
# ============================================================

drp_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#8FCB6A",   # Light green
  "2" = "#E89ABE",   # Pink
  "3" = "#388E3C",   # Dark green
  "4" = "#E6847C",   # Light red
  "5" = "#D32F2F",   # Dark red
  "6" = "#F5A623",   # Orange
  "7" = "#B385C9",   # Purple
  "8" = "#D2A679",   # Brown
  "9" = "#6CB0C4",   # Blue
  "10" = "#800080" 
)

drp_summary <- drug_info %>%
  group_by(DRP) %>%
  summarise(n_drugs = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_drugs))

cat("Number of drugs in each DRP classification:\n")
print(drp_summary)
cat("\n")

# ============================================================
# Step 4: Create network object
# ============================================================

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = drug_pairs_filtered[, c("Drug1", "Drug2", "Spearman_Correlation", "edge_type")],
  directed = FALSE
)

E(g)$weight <- drug_pairs_filtered$Spearman_Correlation
E(g)$edge_type <- drug_pairs_filtered$edge_type

all_nodes <- V(g)$name
V(g)$DRP <- drug_info$DRP[match(all_nodes, drug_info$Drug)]
V(g)$color <- drp_colors[V(g)$DRP]
V(g)$degree <- degree(g)
V(g)$betweenness <- betweenness(g)

cat("Network statistics:\n")
cat("  Number of nodes:", vcount(g), "\n")
cat("  Number of edges:", ecount(g), "\n")
cat("  Average degree:", round(mean(V(g)$degree), 2), "\n\n")

# ============================================================
# 🎯 Key modification: Fix node size parameters
# ============================================================

node_size <- 4  # Uniform node size (adjustable: 3, 4, 5, 6)
node_stroke <- 0.8  # Node border thickness
node_alpha <- 0.9  # Node transparency
tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)

#Plot
# Step 1: Ensure DRP is character type
drug_info <- drug_info %>%
  mutate(DRP = as.character(DRP))

# Step 2: Reassign node attributes
all_nodes <- V(g)$name
V(g)$DRP <- as.character(drug_info$DRP[match(all_nodes, drug_info$Drug)])

# Step 3: Check data
cat("Node DRP type:", class(V(g)$DRP), "\n")
cat("Unique DRP values:", unique(V(g)$DRP), "\n")
cat("Names of the DRP color vector:", names(drp_colors), "\n")

# Step 4: Validate mapping
test_mapping <- data.frame(
  DRP = unique(V(g)$DRP),
  Color = drp_colors[unique(V(g)$DRP)]
)
cat("\nMapping between DRP and colors:\n")
print(test_mapping)

# Step 5: Plot (using the corrected scale_fill_manual)
p4 <- ggraph(tg, layout = 'kk') +
  geom_edge_arc(
    aes(width = weight, alpha = edge_type, color = edge_type),
    strength = 0.15  # Moderate curvature
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.7, 2), name = "Spearman\nCorrelation") +
  scale_edge_alpha_manual(
    values = c("Strong (≥0.7)" = 0.9, "Moderate (0.5-0.7)" = 0.3),
    name = "Edge Type"
  ) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = c("Strong (≥0.7)" = "#D32F2F", "Moderate (0.5-0.7)" = "#7D8086"),
    name = "Edge Type"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(fill = DRP),
    shape = 21, size = node_size, color = "white",
    stroke = node_stroke, alpha = node_alpha
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = drp_colors,
    breaks = sort(unique(V(g)$DRP)),
    labels = paste("DRP", sort(unique(V(g)$DRP))),
    name = "DRP Classification",
    na.translate = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 30,
    bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.08
  ) +
  theme_graph(base_family = 'sans') +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Drug Similarity Network (Medium Curve)",
    subtitle = "Strength = 0.15 | Balanced curvature"
  )

fig_dir <- file.path(paths$results_dir, "output_data")
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Plot01_Drug_Network_Arc_medium.pdf"), 
       p4, width = 16, height = 16)
```


```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Read data ---
drug_pairs_all <- read.xlsx(file.path(input_dir, "01_final_unique_pairs_spearman.xlsx"))

library(readxl)

# Read data
mat_df <- read_excel(file.path(input_dir, "12_Final_L2FC_Matrix_Drugs_Only_367_with_label.xlsx"),
  sheet = 1,  # Specify worksheet
  col_names = TRUE  # Use the first row as column names
)

# Use the first column as row names
row_names <- mat_df[[1]]
mat_df <- mat_df[, -1]

# Convert to matrix
mat <- as.matrix(mat_df)
rownames(mat) <- row_names

# ============================================================
# Calculate key statistics
# ============================================================

# 1. Overall statistics
n_proteins <- nrow(mat)
n_compounds <- ncol(mat)
n_total_possible_edges <- choose(n_compounds, 2)

cat("=== Basic Statistics ===\n")
cat("Total number of proteins:", n_proteins, "\n")
cat("Total number of compounds:", n_compounds, "\n")
cat("Total number of possible compound pairs:", n_total_possible_edges, "\n\n")

# 2. Calculate the number of common proteins between each compound pair
calculate_common_proteins <- function(drug1, drug2, mat) {
  v1 <- mat[, drug1]
  v2 <- mat[, drug2]
  sum(!is.na(v1) & !is.na(v2))
}

# Add the number of common proteins for all drug pairs
drug_pairs_all$n_common_proteins <- mapply(
  calculate_common_proteins,
  drug1 = drug_pairs_all$Drug1,
  drug2 = drug_pairs_all$Drug2,
  MoreArgs = list(mat = mat)
)

# 3. Calculate significance (using the p-value of Spearman correlation here)
calculate_correlation_pvalue <- function(drug1, drug2, mat) {
  v1 <- mat[, drug1]
  v2 <- mat[, drug2]
  ok <- !is.na(v1) & !is.na(v2)
  
  if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA)
  
  test_result <- cor.test(v1[ok], v2[ok], method = "spearman")
  return(test_result$p.value)
}

cat("Calculating correlation significance (p-values)...\n")
drug_pairs_all$p_value <- mapply(
  calculate_correlation_pvalue,
  drug1 = drug_pairs_all$Drug1,
  drug2 = drug_pairs_all$Drug2,
  MoreArgs = list(mat = mat)
)

# 4. FDR correction
drug_pairs_all$fdr <- p.adjust(drug_pairs_all$p_value, method = "fdr")

# 5. Statistics based on different thresholds
# Method 1: Based on FDR (similar to the literature)
fdr_threshold <- 0.01  # 1% FDR
drug_pairs_fdr <- drug_pairs_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(fdr), fdr < fdr_threshold)

# Method 2: Based on correlation threshold (currently used)
cor_threshold <- 0.5
drug_pairs_cor <- drug_pairs_all %>%
  filter(Spearman_Correlation >= cor_threshold)

cat("\n=== Filtering Results ===\n")
cat("Using FDR < 1% threshold:\n")
cat("  Number of significant edges:", nrow(drug_pairs_fdr), "/", n_total_possible_edges, "\n")
cat("  Percentage:", round(nrow(drug_pairs_fdr)/n_total_possible_edges*100, 2), "%\n\n")

cat("Using Spearman ≥ 0.5 threshold:\n")
cat("  Number of significant edges:", nrow(drug_pairs_cor), "/", n_total_possible_edges, "\n")
cat("  Percentage:", round(nrow(drug_pairs_cor)/n_total_possible_edges*100, 2), "%\n\n")

# 6. Select an appropriate threshold for subsequent analysis
# Recommended: combine FDR and correlation
drug_pairs_filtered <- drug_pairs_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(fdr), 
         fdr < 0.01 & Spearman_Correlation >= 0.5)  # 1% FDR + moderate correlation

cat("Using FDR < 1% and Spearman ≥ 0.5:\n")
cat("  Number of edges:", nrow(drug_pairs_filtered), "/", n_total_possible_edges, "\n\n")

# ============================================================
# Network construction and community detection
# ============================================================

# Create network (using filtered data)
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = drug_pairs_filtered[, c("Drug1", "Drug2", "Spearman_Correlation")],
  directed = FALSE
)

E(g)$weight <- drug_pairs_filtered$Spearman_Correlation

# Count the number of compounds with significant connections
compounds_in_network <- unique(c(drug_pairs_filtered$Drug1, drug_pairs_filtered$Drug2))
n_compounds_connected <- length(compounds_in_network)

cat("=== Network Statistics ===\n")
cat("Total number of compounds:", n_compounds, "\n")
cat("Number of compounds with at least one significant connection:", n_compounds_connected, "\n")
cat("Percentage:", round(n_compounds_connected/n_compounds*100, 1), "%\n\n")

# Calculate statistics for the number of common proteins
common_proteins_stats <- summary(drug_pairs_filtered$n_common_proteins)
cat("Statistics of common protein counts between compound pairs:\n")
print(common_proteins_stats)
cat("\nMedian:", median(drug_pairs_filtered$n_common_proteins, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# Community detection
set.seed(123)
communities <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)

cat("=== Community Detection ===\n")
cat("Number of detected communities:", length(communities), "\n")
cat("Sizes of each community:\n")
print(sizes(communities))

# Identify large communities (≥3 compounds)
large_communities <- which(sizes(communities) >= 3)
cat("\nLarge communities (≥3 compounds):", length(large_communities), "\n\n")

# Detailed community information
community_info <- data.frame(
  Compound = V(g)$name,
  Community = membership(communities),
  Degree = degree(g),
  Betweenness = betweenness(g),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add DRP information for each community (if available)
# Here it is assumed that DRP classification information for compounds is available
if (exists("drug_info")) {
  community_info <- community_info %>%
    left_join(drug_info %>% select(Drug, DRP), 
              by = c("Compound" = "Drug"))
}

# ============================================================
# Generate result tables
# ============================================================

# Table 1: Network statistics summary
network_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total proteins",
    "Total compounds",
    "Possible compound pairs",
    "Significant edges (FDR < 1%, r ≥ 0.5)",
    "Percentage of edges",
    "Compounds with ≥1 connection",
    "Percentage of compounds",
    "Median common proteins per pair",
    "Communities detected",
    "Large communities (≥3 compounds)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    n_proteins,
    n_compounds,
    n_total_possible_edges,
    nrow(drug_pairs_filtered),
    paste0(round(nrow(drug_pairs_filtered)/n_total_possible_edges*100, 2), "%"),
    n_compounds_connected,
    paste0(round(n_compounds_connected/n_compounds*100, 1), "%"),
    median(drug_pairs_filtered$n_common_proteins, na.rm = TRUE),
    length(communities),
    length(large_communities)
  )
)

print(network_summary)

# Table 2: Top community details
community_summary <- community_info %>%
  group_by(Community) %>%
  summarise(
    Size = n(),
    Compounds = paste(head(Compound, 5), collapse = "; "),
    Avg_Degree = round(mean(Degree), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Size)) %>%
  head(10)

cat("\n=== Top 10 Communities ===\n")
print(community_summary)

# Export
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Network_Summary" = network_summary,
    "Community_Summary" = community_summary,
    "Community_Details" = community_info,
    "Filtered_Pairs" = drug_pairs_filtered
  ),
  file = file.path(data_dir, "05_Network_Analysis_Summary.xlsx")
)

cat("\n✓ Statistical summary exported\n")
```
